title: President’s address on the eve of 80th Independence Day reflects the nation’s strength and inspires renewed determination for a Viksit Bharat: PM
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today lauded the address delivered by President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu, on the eve of 80th Independence Day noting that it was motivating and thoughtful.
The Prime Minister observed that her thoughts reflect the strength of our nation and the aspirations of every Indian. He stated that her message inspires us all to work with renewed determination for a Viksit Bharat.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister shared:
"A motivating and thoughtful address by Rashtrapati Ji on the eve of Independence Day.
Her thoughts reflect the strength of our nation and the aspirations of every Indian.
Her message inspires us all to work with renewed determination for a Viksit Bharat.
@rashtrapatibhvn"

enrichment.summary: On the eve of the 80th Independence Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised President Droupadi Murmu's address as motivating and thoughtful. He said her message reflects the nation's strength and inspires renewed determination toward achieving a Viksit Bharat (Developed India). The PM shared these remarks in a post on social media platform X.
enrichment.context: This release is a routine reaction/appreciation post by the Prime Minister following the customary presidential address delivered on the eve of Independence Day, a long-standing constitutional and ceremonial tradition in India. The 'Viksit Bharat' (Developed India) vision, targeting India's development by 2047 (100 years of independence), has been a recurring theme in government communication since it was popularized around 2022-2023. This particular release contains no new policy announcement, scheme detail, or substantive content beyond a customary exchange of remarks between constitutional functionaries.
